classification.difficultyReason: Infer an equal side from equal angles and obtain the included angle for area.

content.prompt: Calculate the area of this triangle to 1 d.p.

spec.description: Black triangle ABC with horizontal BC, apex A, AB label outside left edge and 50-degree labels inside both base corners. No visible angle arcs or equal-side ticks.
spec.mathematics: AB=8 cm; angle ABC=angle BCA=50 degrees. AC and BC unlabelled. Preserve source not-to-scale silhouette.

answer.worked:
Equal angles have equal opposite sides, so $AC=AB=8\text{ cm}$.
$$\begin{align*}
\angle BAC&=180^\circ-50^\circ-50^\circ=80^\circ\\[8pt]
A&=\frac12(8)(8)\sin80^\circ\\[8pt]
A&\approx31.5\text{ cm}^2
\end{align*}$$
